english.title: Apply monies released for a purpose not in a statement made under reg 21(3)(a) / 21(3)(c)
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[organiser]_
(B)_[retailer]_
(C)_[organiser and retailer]_

of a contract, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONTRACT..), applied monies released to you on the basis of a statement made by you under regulation

(D)_[21(3)(a)]_

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
INDICTMENT: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
